children: ) returns to Seoul on October 22–23, 2026, for its second annual pop-up, giving Korean fans and partners exclusive first access to its Fall / Winter 2026 merchandise collection. In October 2025, the inaugural Seoul pop-up welcomed nearly 5,000 visitors, and Korea continues to serve as one of Palantir’s largest international markets for merchandise. South Korea is one of Palantir’s largest commercial markets outside the United States, with growing momentum as organizations use Palantir’s software to tackle consequential challenges. Korean companies are global leaders, shaping industries and supply chains around the world. Sovereign AI enables these institutions to harness AI on their own terms while retaining control over the data, operations, and expertise that underpin their global competitiveness.

The theme of this year’s event will be Sovereign AI, reflecting the company’s broader belief that organizations should be able to deploy AI on their own terms, with complete control over their data, operations, and institutional expertise.
Last year's pop-up reached capacity during peak hours. Advance registration is strongly encouraged to secure a time slot.
Hannam-dong, Seoul (address to be released October 21)
: Opens October 13 at 10AM KST at store.palantir.com/ROK

Advance registration is strongly encouraged to secure a time slot. Registration opens 10AM KST on October 13 at store.palantir.com/ROK. Upon registering, attendees receive neighborhood and general location details, plus date and time slot confirmation. The exact venue address, Naver Map link, subway and taxi directions, accessibility information, and arrival instructions will be sent 24 hours before the event.
Walk-up access is available subject to capacity, with limited same-day registration spots available on a first-come, first-served basis.

Known for its dynamic mix of fashion, art, design, and hospitality, Hannam has become a destination for discovering new ideas and experiences. The pop-up brings Palantir into this vibrant cultural context, inviting visitors to explore the collection through an immersive, creatively curious experience rooted in the energy of Seoul.
Foundational software of tomorrow. Delivered today. Additional information is available at https://www.palantir.com.
